newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos in hospital for pains in joints.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos in hospital for pains in joints.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos was admitted to hospital on Thursday night after he complained of pains in his joints, doctors attending to him said on Friday.
"All tests performed on him indicate a protracted systemic viral infection," attending physician Raul Fores of the Makati Medical Centre said in a medical bulletin.
Fores said Ramos, who is 68 years old, will undergo several tests and is expected to remain in hospital until Sunday.
